items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed. Exact decision: retain the production and security-sensitive release gates; keep gated public exposure private; allow ordinary reversible growth only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. The two LCP candidates are conditionally acceptable from a security perspective but remain deferred because authoritative queue state shows active measurement blockers. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or findings; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; security site facts are unknown across 61 sites; authentication/access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. Compliance is technical-only at 38 pass, 22 fail, and 1 unknown. No credential exposure, exploit, or active incident is evidenced; missing evidence is not clearance. TLS has no certificates expiring within 30 days, but broader TLS configuration evidence is absent. Severity: high for go-live and security-sensitive releases; informational/medium for ordinary reversible growth.

items.title: Maintain evidence-needed fleet security gate and complete bounded control matrix
items.summary: Fleet-wide security clearance is unsupported because fleet-doctor and operations evidence are unavailable and material controls remain unevidenced. Preserve private launch gates while continuing bounded read-only evidence capture from authorized artifacts only.
items.requested_action: Document evidence timestamps, owners, scope, severity, and release implications for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, container isolation, release and deploy controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring and incident signals, and security.txt/disclosure readiness. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, activate analytics, expand monetization, or request duplicate telemetry. Reassess only when concrete evidence exists.
